descriptions.CONNECTOR_VALIDATION: Validates that the connector is configured correctly and reachable before fetching begins.
descriptions.PERMISSION_VALIDATION: Verifies the credential has the permissions needed to read documents from the source.
descriptions.CHECKPOINT_LOAD: Loads any prior checkpoint so a resumed attempt can pick up where the last one left off.
descriptions.CONNECTOR_FETCH: Time spent calling the upstream source to retrieve a batch of raw documents.
descriptions.HIERARCHY_UPSERT: Records hierarchy and metadata relationships (folders, parents, etc.) for the batch in Postgres.
descriptions.DOC_BATCH_STORE: Persists the fetched batch to the file store so the docprocessing worker can consume it asynchronously.
descriptions.DOC_BATCH_ENQUEUE: Submits a docprocessing task for the batch onto the Celery queue.
descriptions.QUEUE_WAIT: Time the docprocessing task spent waiting in the Celery queue before a worker picked it up.
descriptions.DOCPROCESSING_SETUP: One-time setup the docprocessing worker performs before processing batches (DB session, embedder, etc.).
descriptions.BATCH_LOAD: Reads the batch back from the file store inside the docprocessing worker.
descriptions.DOC_DB_PREPARE: Cleans, dedupes, and prepares documents for indexing — includes the DB lookups against existing document state.
descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING: Extracts and processes images embedded in document sections.
descriptions.CHUNKING: Splits documents into chunks sized for the embedding model.
descriptions.CONTEXTUAL_RAG: Optional LLM call that adds short contextual summaries to each chunk to improve retrieval quality.
descriptions.EMBEDDING: Calls the embedding model to produce vectors for each chunk.
descriptions.DOC_LOCK_ACQUIRE_WAIT: Time spent waiting to acquire the per-document row locks before writing — the wait only, not the write done while holding them (that is Vector DB write / Post-index DB update). High values mean documents are contended across connectors.
descriptions.ENRICHMENT_PREP: Per-batch DB lookups that enrich chunks before writing — access info, document sets, ancestors, and prior chunk counts.
descriptions.VECTOR_DB_WRITE: Writes the embedded chunks and their metadata to Vespa.
descriptions.POST_INDEX_DB_UPDATE: Updates Postgres with final document state after indexing (last-indexed timestamps, hashes, etc.).
descriptions.GRAPH_EXTRACTION_ENQUEUE: Enqueues background Celery tasks to extract Knowledge Graph entities and relationships from the indexed document.
descriptions.COORD_LOCK_ACQUIRE_WAIT: Time spent waiting to acquire the connector-wide coordination lock that every batch serializes on — the wait only, not the update done while holding it (that is Coordination update). High values mean batch-level contention.
descriptions.COORDINATION_UPDATE: Bookkeeping updates after a batch — progress counters, checkpoint advances, and similar.
